info.title: Behemot API
info.description: Session-cookie authentication: log in through POST /auth/login, then reuse the behemot-api-sid cookie. Bearer tokens are not supported. CRUD lists exclude soft-deleted records. Global rate limit: 200 requests per IP per 10 minutes. Validation errors use HTTP 422 with error.issues.

tags.name: Operations
tags.description: Operational endpoints registered directly on the application.

tags.name: Car generations
tags.description: CAR_GENERATION management. endProduction must be null or greater than or equal to startProduction.

tags.name: Departments
tags.description: DEPARTMENT management. The shortcut is converted to uppercase. Name and shortcut must be available among non-deleted departments.

tags.name: Integrations
tags.description: Integration overview and configuration. Credentials and settings are never returned.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: PRODUCT management. The listing template must belong to the selected department. Active products have unique SKU; EAN may repeat. Fitments may specify only a brand, a model or a generation; parent IDs are normalized and validated. Removing a fitment linked to an active external listing is forbidden. Listing content is rendered from the template, with optional custom summary and description; rendering failures are returned in listingContentError. Without a template, customName, customSummary and customDescription are returned as content, with missing values left null and HTML sanitized. Import allows incomplete products. A full panel save takes over a legacy product and atomically increments contentVersion. Quantity is read-only. A product and its fitments may have multiple active listings on the same integration account and channel. Each external offer identity is unique within its integration account; distinct offer IDs remain separate listings. Synchronization is disabled until real updates are implemented.

tags.name: Product cross-references
tags.description: PRODUCT_CROSS_REFERENCE management. The product/contractor/SKU combination and each non-null contractor EAN must be available among non-deleted cross-references.

tags.name: Product fitments
tags.description: PRODUCT_FITMENT management. A product can have at most one primary fitment and one fitment for a given brand/model/generation combination. Supply at least one vehicle ID; parent IDs are normalized and validated. A fitment cannot be moved to another product.

tags.name: Product listing templates
tags.description: PRODUCT_LISTING_TEMPLATE management. Name is trimmed and must be available among non-deleted templates. All template fields must contain text. Unknown or malformed placeholders are rejected. Rich text is sanitized before saving.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Roles and assigned privileges. Rejected write requests by authenticated users are recorded in the audit history as FAILED.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User management. Requires corresponding USER privileges. Rejected write requests by authenticated users are recorded in the audit history as FAILED.

tags.name: Warehouses
tags.description: WAREHOUSE management. The name must be available among non-deleted warehouses.

post.summary: Check connection and refresh account data
post.description: Requires INTEGRATION:UPDATE. Supports ERLI, PrestaShop and eMAG. A completed check returns HTTP 200 with the updated integration and an optional safe error. Connection failures persist ERROR diagnostics and retain previous account data. Does not change isEnabled. PrestaShop selects the first returned shop. eMAG checks API access through product_offer/count on the RO endpoint; its public API has no seller-profile endpoint.

200.description: Check completed; inspect integration.status and error.

404.description: Integration not found or deleted during the check.

post.description: Requires INTEGRATION:CREATE. ERLI accepts {token}; PRESTASHOP accepts {baseUrl, apiKey}; EMAG accepts {username, password}, with an email username. All channels use the same creation service and return one integration with HTTP 201. Duplicate active account configurations are rejected with HTTP 409. eMAG uses only the RO API for now, without separate market configurations.
